summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing positive drill results from its Terronera operation in Mexico. The release details exploration findings from 53 drill holes totaling 8,919 metres on the La Luz system and Terronera vein, including high-grade intercepts such as 2,607 g/t AgEq over 1.06 metres. There is no mention of any transaction, strategic review, activist involvement, or corporate event that would constitute a special situation. The filing is a routine operational update that does not trigger any category under the special-situations framework.
